values.Example: We took a boat to a small island.
values.ExampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đi thuyền ra một hòn đảo nhỏ.
values.MeaningEn: a piece of land with water all around it
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"We took a boat to a small island.","vi":"Ch\u00FAng t\u00F4i \u0111i thuy\u1EC1n ra m\u1ED9t h\u00F2n \u0111\u1EA3o nh\u1ECF."},{"text":"Phu Quoc is a beautiful island.","vi":"Ph\u00FA Qu\u1ED1c l\u00E0 m\u1ED9t h\u00F2n \u0111\u1EA3o \u0111\u1EB9p."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"tropical island","vi":"\u0111\u1EA3o nhi\u1EC7t \u0111\u1EDBi"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: We walk on the beach every morning.
values.ExampleTranslation: Sáng nào chúng tôi cũng đi dạo trên bãi biển.
values.MeaningEn: an area of sand or small stones next to the sea
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"We walk on the beach every morning.","vi":"S\u00E1ng n\u00E0o ch\u00FAng t\u00F4i c\u0169ng \u0111i d\u1EA1o tr\u00EAn b\u00E3i bi\u1EC3n."},{"text":"The children built a sandcastle on the beach.","vi":"B\u1ECDn tr\u1EBB x\u00E2y m\u1ED9t l\u00E2u \u0111\u00E0i c\u00E1t tr\u00EAn b\u00E3i bi\u1EC3n."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"sandy beach","vi":"b\u00E3i bi\u1EC3n c\u00E1t"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The sand was hot under my feet.
values.ExampleTranslation: Cát nóng dưới chân tôi.
values.MeaningEn: tiny pieces of rock that cover beaches and deserts
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The sand was hot under my feet.","vi":"C\u00E1t n\u00F3ng d\u01B0\u1EDBi ch\u00E2n t\u00F4i."},{"text":"The children played in the sand.","vi":"B\u1ECDn tr\u1EBB ch\u01A1i \u0111\u00F9a trong c\u00E1t."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"sand dune","vi":"\u0111\u1EE5n c\u00E1t"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: A big wave hit the rocks.
values.ExampleTranslation: Một con sóng lớn đập vào ghềnh đá.
values.MeaningEn: a line of water that moves across the sea
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"A big wave hit the rocks.","vi":"M\u1ED9t con s\u00F3ng l\u1EDBn \u0111\u1EADp v\u00E0o gh\u1EC1nh \u0111\u00E1."},{"text":"The waves are high today.","vi":"H\u00F4m nay s\u00F3ng cao."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"big wave","vi":"s\u00F3ng l\u1EDBn"}],"wordFamily":[],"verbForms":{"past":"waved","pastParticiple":"waved","ing":"waving","thirdPerson":"waves"}}

values.Example: We walked through the forest on Sunday.
values.ExampleTranslation: Chủ nhật chúng tôi đi bộ xuyên qua khu rừng.
values.MeaningEn: a large area covered with trees
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"We walked through the forest on Sunday.","vi":"Ch\u1EE7 nh\u1EADt ch\u00FAng t\u00F4i \u0111i b\u1ED9 xuy\u00EAn qua khu r\u1EEBng."},{"text":"Many animals live in the forest.","vi":"Nhi\u1EC1u lo\u00E0i v\u1EADt s\u1ED1ng trong r\u1EEBng."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"rain forest","vi":"r\u1EEBng nhi\u1EC7t \u0111\u1EDBi"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: We stood on the cliff and watched the sea.
values.ExampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đứng trên vách đá nhìn ra biển.
values.MeaningEn: a high steep rock face next to the sea
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"We stood on the cliff and watched the sea.","vi":"Ch\u00FAng t\u00F4i \u0111\u1EE9ng tr\u00EAn v\u00E1ch \u0111\u00E1 nh\u00ECn ra bi\u1EC3n."},{"text":"Be careful near the edge of the cliff.","vi":"H\u00E3y c\u1EA9n th\u1EADn g\u1EA7n m\u00E9p v\u00E1ch \u0111\u00E1."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"cliff edge","vi":"m\u00E9p v\u00E1ch \u0111\u00E1"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The sky is clear and blue today.
values.ExampleTranslation: Hôm nay bầu trời trong và xanh.
values.MeaningEn: the space above the Earth where you see clouds and the sun
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The sky is clear and blue today.","vi":"H\u00F4m nay b\u1EA7u tr\u1EDDi trong v\u00E0 xanh."},{"text":"Birds are flying across the sky.","vi":"Nh\u1EEFng con chim \u0111ang bay ngang b\u1EA7u tr\u1EDDi."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"blue sky","vi":"b\u1EA7u tr\u1EDDi xanh"},{"text":"night sky","vi":"b\u1EA7u tr\u1EDDi \u0111\u00EAm"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: We watched the sunset from the beach.
values.ExampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ngắm hoàng hôn từ bãi biển.
values.MeaningEn: the time in the evening when the sun goes down
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"We watched the sunset from the beach.","vi":"Ch\u00FAng t\u00F4i ng\u1EAFm ho\u00E0ng h\u00F4n t\u1EEB b\u00E3i bi\u1EC3n."},{"text":"The sunset turned the sky orange.","vi":"Ho\u00E0ng h\u00F4n nhu\u1ED9m b\u1EA7u tr\u1EDDi th\u00E0nh m\u00E0u cam."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"watch the sunset","vi":"ng\u1EAFm ho\u00E0ng h\u00F4n"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The volcano erupted last year.
values.ExampleTranslation: Ngọn núi lửa đã phun trào vào năm ngoái.
values.MeaningEn: a mountain that sometimes throws out hot melted rock
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The volcano erupted last year.","vi":"Ng\u1ECDn n\u00FAi l\u1EEDa \u0111\u00E3 phun tr\u00E0o v\u00E0o n\u0103m ngo\u00E1i."},{"text":"Smoke rises from the top of the volcano.","vi":"Kh\u00F3i b\u1ED1c l\u00EAn t\u1EEB \u0111\u1EC9nh n\u00FAi l\u1EEDa."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"active volcano","vi":"n\u00FAi l\u1EEDa \u0111ang ho\u1EA1t \u0111\u1ED9ng"}],"wordFamily":[],"plural":"volcanoes"}

values.Example: We climbed the mountain last summer.
values.ExampleTranslation: Mùa hè năm ngoái chúng tôi leo ngọn núi đó.
values.MeaningEn: a very high hill, often with snow on top
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"We climbed the mountain last summer.","vi":"M\u00F9a h\u00E8 n\u0103m ngo\u00E1i ch\u00FAng t\u00F4i leo ng\u1ECDn n\u00FAi \u0111\u00F3."},{"text":"The mountain is covered with snow.","vi":"Ng\u1ECDn n\u00FAi ph\u1EE7 \u0111\u1EA7y tuy\u1EBFt."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"climb a mountain","vi":"leo n\u00FAi"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: A small river runs through the valley.
values.ExampleTranslation: Một con sông nhỏ chảy qua thung lũng.
values.MeaningEn: a low area of land between two hills or mountains
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"A small river runs through the valley.","vi":"M\u1ED9t con s\u00F4ng nh\u1ECF ch\u1EA3y qua thung l\u0169ng."},{"text":"The valley is full of flowers in spring.","vi":"Thung l\u0169ng \u0111\u1EA7y hoa v\u00E0o m\u00F9a xu\u00E2n."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"green valley","vi":"thung l\u0169ng xanh"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The children swim in the lake in summer.
values.ExampleTranslation: Mùa hè bọn trẻ bơi ở hồ.
values.MeaningEn: a large area of water with land all around it
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The children swim in the lake in summer.","vi":"M\u00F9a h\u00E8 b\u1ECDn tr\u1EBB b\u01A1i \u1EDF h\u1ED3."},{"text":"There is a quiet lake near our village.","vi":"C\u00F3 m\u1ED9t c\u00E1i h\u1ED3 y\u00EAn t\u0129nh g\u1EA7n l\u00E0ng ch\u00FAng t\u00F4i."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"by the lake","vi":"c\u1EA1nh h\u1ED3"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: We swam below the waterfall.
values.ExampleTranslation: Chúng tôi bơi bên dưới thác nước.
values.MeaningEn: water that falls from a high place down a cliff
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"We swam below the waterfall.","vi":"Ch\u00FAng t\u00F4i b\u01A1i b\u00EAn d\u01B0\u1EDBi th\u00E1c n\u01B0\u1EDBc."},{"text":"The waterfall is more than fifty metres high.","vi":"Th\u00E1c n\u01B0\u1EDBc cao h\u01A1n n\u0103m m\u01B0\u01A1i m\u00E9t."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"visit a waterfall","vi":"th\u0103m th\u00E1c n\u01B0\u1EDBc"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: A yellow leaf fell on my desk.
values.ExampleTranslation: Một chiếc lá vàng rơi xuống bàn tôi.
values.MeaningEn: a flat green part that grows on a plant
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"A yellow leaf fell on my desk.","vi":"M\u1ED9t chi\u1EBFc l\u00E1 v\u00E0ng r\u01A1i xu\u1ED1ng b\u00E0n t\u00F4i."},{"text":"The leaves change colour in autumn.","vi":"L\u00E1 \u0111\u1ED5i m\u00E0u v\u00E0o m\u00F9a thu."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"green leaf","vi":"l\u00E1 xanh"}],"wordFamily":[],"plural":"leaves"}

values.Example: We explored a dark cave with a torch.
values.ExampleTranslation: Chúng tôi khám phá một hang động tối bằng đèn pin.
values.MeaningEn: a large hole in the side of a hill or under the ground
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"We explored a dark cave with a torch.","vi":"Ch\u00FAng t\u00F4i kh\u00E1m ph\u00E1 m\u1ED9t hang \u0111\u1ED9ng t\u1ED1i b\u1EB1ng \u0111\u00E8n pin."},{"text":"Bats sleep in the cave all day.","vi":"D\u01A1i ng\u1EE7 trong hang c\u1EA3 ng\u00E0y."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"explore a cave","vi":"kh\u00E1m ph\u00E1 hang \u0111\u1ED9ng"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: We spent the summer by the sea.
values.ExampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đã nghỉ hè ở bên bờ biển.
values.MeaningEn: a large area of salt water
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"We spent the summer by the sea.","vi":"Ch\u00FAng t\u00F4i \u0111\u00E3 ngh\u1EC9 h\u00E8 \u1EDF b\u00EAn b\u1EDD bi\u1EC3n."},{"text":"The sea is calm and blue today.","vi":"H\u00F4m nay bi\u1EC3n l\u1EB7ng v\u00E0 xanh."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"swim in the sea","vi":"b\u01A1i \u1EDF bi\u1EC3n"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: He sat on a big rock by the river.
values.ExampleTranslation: Anh ấy ngồi trên một tảng đá lớn bên sông.
values.MeaningEn: a large piece of hard stone
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"He sat on a big rock by the river.","vi":"Anh \u1EA5y ng\u1ED3i tr\u00EAn m\u1ED9t t\u1EA3ng \u0111\u00E1 l\u1EDBn b\u00EAn s\u00F4ng."},{"text":"The path was full of sharp rocks.","vi":"Con \u0111\u01B0\u1EDDng \u0111\u1EA7y nh\u1EEFng t\u1EA3ng \u0111\u00E1 s\u1EAFc nh\u1ECDn."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"climb the rocks","vi":"tr\u00E8o l\u00EAn \u0111\u00E1"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: Tigers live in the jungle.
values.ExampleTranslation: Hổ sống trong rừng rậm.
values.MeaningEn: a thick hot forest with many plants and animals
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"Tigers live in the jungle.","vi":"H\u1ED5 s\u1ED1ng trong r\u1EEBng r\u1EADm."},{"text":"The jungle was hot and very wet.","vi":"Khu r\u1EEBng r\u1EADm v\u1EEBa n\u00F3ng v\u1EEBa \u1EA9m \u01B0\u1EDBt."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"deep jungle","vi":"r\u1EEBng s\u00E2u"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The farmer works in the rice field.
values.ExampleTranslation: Người nông dân làm việc trên cánh đồng lúa.
values.MeaningEn: a large area of land used for crops or animals
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The farmer works in the rice field.","vi":"Ng\u01B0\u1EDDi n\u00F4ng d\u00E2n l\u00E0m vi\u1EC7c tr\u00EAn c\u00E1nh \u0111\u1ED3ng l\u00FAa."},{"text":"Cows are eating grass in the field.","vi":"Nh\u1EEFng con b\u00F2 \u0111ang \u0103n c\u1ECF tr\u00EAn c\u00E1nh \u0111\u1ED3ng."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"rice field","vi":"ru\u1ED9ng l\u00FAa"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: She gave me a red flower.
values.ExampleTranslation: Cô ấy tặng tôi một bông hoa đỏ.
values.MeaningEn: the colourful part of a plant
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"She gave me a red flower.","vi":"C\u00F4 \u1EA5y t\u1EB7ng t\u00F4i m\u1ED9t b\u00F4ng hoa \u0111\u1ECF."},{"text":"The garden is full of beautiful flowers.","vi":"Khu v\u01B0\u1EDDn \u0111\u1EA7y nh\u1EEFng b\u00F4ng hoa \u0111\u1EB9p."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"pick a flower","vi":"h\u00E1i hoa"},{"text":"bunch of flowers","vi":"b\u00F3 hoa"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: There is a big tree in front of our house.
values.ExampleTranslation: Có một cái cây lớn trước nhà chúng tôi.
values.MeaningEn: a tall plant with a thick trunk and branches
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"There is a big tree in front of our house.","vi":"C\u00F3 m\u1ED9t c\u00E1i c\u00E2y l\u1EDBn tr\u01B0\u1EDBc nh\u00E0 ch\u00FAng t\u00F4i."},{"text":"The cat climbed up the tree.","vi":"Con m\u00E8o tr\u00E8o l\u00EAn c\u00E2y."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"plant a tree","vi":"tr\u1ED3ng c\u00E2y"},{"text":"climb a tree","vi":"tr\u00E8o c\u00E2y"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The village is on top of a green hill.
values.ExampleTranslation: Ngôi làng nằm trên đỉnh một ngọn đồi xanh.
values.MeaningEn: a high area of land that is smaller than a mountain
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The village is on top of a green hill.","vi":"Ng\u00F4i l\u00E0ng n\u1EB1m tr\u00EAn \u0111\u1EC9nh m\u1ED9t ng\u1ECDn \u0111\u1ED3i xanh."},{"text":"We rode our bikes up the hill.","vi":"Ch\u00FAng t\u00F4i \u0111\u1EA1p xe l\u00EAn \u0111\u1ED3i."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"top of the hill","vi":"\u0111\u1EC9nh \u0111\u1ED3i"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: It almost never rains in the desert.
values.ExampleTranslation: Ở sa mạc hầu như không bao giờ mưa.
values.MeaningEn: a very dry area with sand and few plants
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"It almost never rains in the desert.","vi":"\u1EDE sa m\u1EA1c h\u1EA7u nh\u01B0 kh\u00F4ng bao gi\u1EDD m\u01B0a."},{"text":"We crossed the desert on camels.","vi":"Ch\u00FAng t\u00F4i b\u0103ng qua sa m\u1EA1c b\u1EB1ng l\u1EA1c \u0111\u00E0."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"hot desert","vi":"sa m\u1EA1c n\u00F3ng"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The children are sitting on the grass.
values.ExampleTranslation: Bọn trẻ đang ngồi trên bãi cỏ.
values.MeaningEn: a green plant with thin leaves that covers the ground
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The children are sitting on the grass.","vi":"B\u1ECDn tr\u1EBB \u0111ang ng\u1ED3i tr\u00EAn b\u00E3i c\u1ECF."},{"text":"The grass is wet after the rain.","vi":"C\u1ECF \u01B0\u1EDBt sau c\u01A1n m\u01B0a."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"cut the grass","vi":"c\u1EAFt c\u1ECF"}],"wordFamily":[]}

values.Example: The river is wide and slow here.
values.ExampleTranslation: Dòng sông ở đây rộng và chảy chậm.
values.MeaningEn: a long stream of water that flows to the sea
values.DetailsJson: {"examples":[{"text":"The river is wide and slow here.","vi":"D\u00F2ng s\u00F4ng \u1EDF \u0111\u00E2y r\u1ED9ng v\u00E0 ch\u1EA3y ch\u1EADm."},{"text":"We had a picnic by the river.","vi":"Ch\u00FAng t\u00F4i \u0111i d\u00E3 ngo\u1EA1i b\u00EAn b\u1EDD s\u00F4ng."}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"collocations":[{"text":"cross a river","vi":"qua s\u00F4ng"},{"text":"river bank","vi":"b\u1EDD s\u00F4ng"}],"wordFamily":[]}
